content_zh:
门开了，颀长俊挺的男人步伐有些虚浮，身着银灰色衬衫，长身玉立，如一束月光，眩惑的姿态，一举手一投足间皆有风情流动。
他站在床边，淡淡地看着床上喃喃梦呓的她，勾唇冷笑，有几分讥诮，不疾不徐扯掉领带，上床……
狂热急促的吻似急骤的雨点不停落下，从光洁的额、粉嫩的颊，再到甜美的唇瓣。略带粗糙的大手粗暴地扯掉她薄薄的睡裙，恣意享受她嫩滑似婴儿肌肤所带来的美妙触感。
她沉陷于梦境之中倘未完全清醒，娇躯却好似熟悉了这吻和触摸，轻喘着，虽不抗拒，还是不禁辗转着小脸，微躲他的吻。
她无意识的躲避惹得他更加激狂的吻和爱抚，男人颀长的身躯沉沉压住她，大手急切地拉开她修长玉腿，下一秒，沉腰，进入，侵占……
“啊……”女人终于清醒，惊愕瞪大美眸看着压在自己身上的男人，秀眉因为身子被他狂猛的侵略而紧蹙。
她被吓坏的模样似乎大大地取悦了男人，俊美的脸上扬起好看的弧度，笑容里有泯灭的光，却达不到眼底，眼底是一片冰冷，随后大掌将粉嫩的翘臀抬得更高，迎向自己，让火热的欲望进入得最深。
“少卿……”她强忍下申呤，疑惑而哀怨的眼睛看着他，他不是在和新签的绝色女代言人开庆功宴吗？脑中电光火石般闪过美丽的女代言人温柔挽着他的手臂，指尖碰着他的西服不肯松手，柔柔媚媚地喊着他‘顾总’。
他身上淡淡的Dior魅惑香味钻进她鼻子，她恨死了他身上带着别的女人的香水味碰她……
“放开……”还未等她开口，薄唇已经飞快地攫住她的唇，不由分说地撬开贝齿，将喉间发出一阵阵愉悦又狂野的低吼声隐入她口中。
她被吻得透不过气来，他抬头盯着她的眼睛，“不想知道我为什么丢下美人，这么晚赶回来要你？”
心脏里弥漫出小小的酸楚，泪腺充盈，她别开脸，“对不起，我不想知道，放开我……”
他咬上她精致的耳垂，坏心地呵出热气，“因为我算准了今晚是你的排卵期……”
她淡淡笑起来，泪滑落，浅浅的梨涡，那笑如同出水的清莲，缓慢而坚定地绽放，美得无以复加。
“顾少卿，在你没爱上我之前，我绝对不会怀你的孩子。”

content_en:
The door opened, and there was a tall, handsome man with a somewhat frivolous pace. He was wearing a silver-gray shirt, and his long body was like a beam of moonlight. His posture was dazzling, and his every move, hand, and foot was full of charm.
He stood by the bed and looked at her murmuring on the bed. He curled his lips and sneered, a bit sarcastic. He slowly took off his tie and got into bed...
The passionate and rapid kisses fell like rapid raindrops, from the smooth forehead, pink cheeks, to the sweet lips. His slightly rough hands roughly pulled off her thin nightgown, enjoying the wonderful touch of her tender, baby-like skin.
She was immersed in a dream and was not fully awake, but her delicate body seemed to be familiar with the kiss and touch. She was panting lightly. Although she did not resist, she could not help but turn her face and slightly avoid his kiss.
Her unconscious avoidance provoked him to kiss and caress more passionately. The man's tall body pressed heavily on her, and his big hands eagerly opened her slender legs. In the next second, he lowered his waist, entered, and occupied...
"Ah..." The woman finally woke up and looked at the man pressing on her with wide beautiful eyes in shock, her beautiful eyebrows frowning because her body was violently invaded by him.
Her frightened look seemed to please the man greatly. There was a beautiful curve on her handsome face, and there was a annihilated light in her smile, but it did not reach the eyes, which were cold. Then her big palms raised her pink buttocks higher to face her, allowing the hot desire to penetrate deepest.
"Shaoqing..." She forced Shen Ling to look at him with doubtful and sad eyes. Wasn't he having a celebration banquet with the newly signed stunning female spokesperson? Flashes of lightning flashed through his mind as the beautiful female spokesperson gently held his arm, her fingertips touched his suit and refused to let go, calling him "Mr. Gu" softly and charmingly.
His faint charming fragrance of Dior penetrated her nose, and she hated him so much that he touched her with the scent of another woman's perfume...
"Let go..." Before she could say anything, his thin lips had quickly grabbed hers, prying open the teeth without any explanation, and let out waves of pleasant and wild growls from his throat into her mouth.
She was breathless from the kiss, and he raised his head and stared into her eyes, "Don't you want to know why I left this beauty behind and came back so late to ask for you?"
There was a little sadness in her heart and her tear ducts were full. She turned away and said, "I'm sorry, I don't want to know, let me go..."
He bit her delicate earlobe and exhaled hot breath maliciously, "Because I've calculated that tonight is your ovulation period..."
She smiled faintly, with tears falling down her cheeks. Her smile was like a clear lotus emerging from the water, blooming slowly but firmly, so beautiful that it couldn't be more beautiful.
"Gu Shaoqing, before you fall in love with me, I will never be pregnant with your child."
